title: Import Intel
description:
Imports threat data to Intel Exchange.

The formats supported for import are as follows:

  
    MISP
    misp
    .json
    misp
  
  
    Open IOC
    openioc
    .xml
    openioc
  
  
    STIX 1.x
    stix1
    .xml
    .xml
  
  
    STIX 2.1
    stix2
    .json
    Stix2
  
  
    STIX 2.0
    stix20
    .json
    Stix2
  
  
    STIX 1.x URL
    stix1url
    URL
    url
  
  
    CSV (Recorded Future)
    csv-recorded-future
    .csv
    csv
  
  
    CSV (Cyware)
    cy-csv
    .csv
    csv
  

Optionally, you can specify a collection to which the file is imported. If no collection is specified, the data is imported to the default collection. To retrieve import collections, use the **Get Source Collections** endpoint.

> [!NOTE]
> For STIX 1.x URL, the body must include the URL value. For more information, see the example request.

query.name: version
query.description: If the format (path variable) value is stix1 or stix2, enter the STIX version.

body.name: file
body.description: Select the file to be imported.

body.name: collection_id
body.description: Enter the ID of the collection to which the file is imported. To retrieve the `collection_id`, use the **Get Source Collections** endpoint. Data is imported to both the default collection as well as this specified collection.

path.name: format
path.description: Pass the format for the import. Refer to preceding table for more information.

body.name: details
body.description: Returns the import status details. To confirm if the intel was successfully imported, sign in to the Intel Exchange platform and check the Notifications section.
body.value: You will be notified once file got uploaded.
